rt.doc: Every datagram carries proto and type. session is the session id: producers send 8 hex characters; acceptors take 1-15 alphanumerics. drive and bye carry seq; hello and view do not. view (on the video port) may carry key:true to ask for a keyframe.

version.doc: GET /version: who this board is and what it runs. The one document whose shape never changes: no field is ever added, renamed or removed; anything else belongs in /status, which lives under proto. A board that answers 404 predates this endpoint and is updated.

fields.name: device
fields.doc: the device name — this contract's own device constant

fields.name: fw
fields.doc: firmware version as the build prints it: v<semver>+<build>[-<n>-g<sha>[-dirty]]

fields.name: build
fields.doc: the number after + in fw, parsed by the firmware; -1 when fw carries none

fields.name: proto
fields.doc: the protocol number of everything else this board serves — this contract's proto

fields.name: rolled_back
fields.doc: the bootloader reverted the last update; sticky until the next successful OTA

device.doc: Who is answering — the object in the hello reply. Version and identity for the launch gate come from /version.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: the device name; ajmiddlecar for this car

fields.name: fw
fields.doc: firmware version, v<semver>+<build>

fields.name: build
fields.doc: the number after + in fw, as an integer

fields.name: rolled_back
fields.doc: the bootloader reverted the last update

link.doc: The control link as the car sees it.

fields.name: rx_hz
fields.doc: drive commands accepted per second; a datagram the proto, owner or sequence gate refuses is not counted

fields.name: rssi_dbm
fields.doc: the driving station's signal at the car, null when not measured

fields.name: timeouts
fields.doc: control-watchdog trips since boot

motors.doc: The actuator: its bus, its calibration, and who is commanding it.

fields.name: bus
fields.doc: both PWM boards up and the last write accepted

fields.name: calibrated
fields.doc: a valid wheel calibration is loaded

fields.name: owner
fields.doc: which source owns the actuator

radio.doc: The C6 radio co-processor's firmware against what this build expects.

fields.name: fw
fields.doc: the radio's version, null when it did not answer

fields.name: expected
fields.doc: the version this build was made for

fields.name: state
fields.doc: ok when fw equals expected

storage.doc: What happened to the settings at this boot.

fields.name: reset_at_boot
fields.doc: the NVS format changed and every setting went back to its default

fields.name: uptime_s
fields.doc: seconds since boot

fields.name: free_heap
fields.doc: free heap in bytes

video.doc: The camera and the FPV stream.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: off: no sensor answered at boot; idle: sensor in standby, nobody watching; streaming: encoding for the driver

fields.name: fps
fields.doc: frames sent in the last second, counted at the sender's output when a frame's last chunk leaves, not at the encoder

fields.name: kbps
fields.doc: kbit sent in the last second

fields.name: dropped
fields.doc: frames not sent since boot: the sender was still busy with the previous frame, the encoder overflowed, or the frame needed more than 255 chunks

telemetry.doc: The 5 Hz push: proto, type, seq, then these groups.

config.doc: GET returns every domain; POST takes any subset of domains, each complete, validates the whole body before applying any of it, and answers with the full configuration as now held.

domains.doc: Slew-rate limit on acceleration. Rise is bounded, fall is instant, so stopping is never delayed.

fields.name: rise_ms
fields.doc: time from zero to full scale in ms; 0 disables the ramp

domains.doc: Straight-line correction. Positive slows the left side, negative slows the right; it only ever attenuates.

fields.name: balance_pct
fields.doc: percentage by which the faster side is slowed

domains.doc: Reverse-replay retreat on unexpected link loss. A deliberate goodbye suppresses it.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: retrace on unexpected silence; when false the car stops instead

fields.name: window_ms
fields.doc: how far back the breadcrumb history reaches; capped below rt.session_idle_ms so a full-window retrace ends before the session does

domains.doc: Wheel and encoder geometry. Stored on the car; speed is not yet computed from it.

fields.name: diameter_mm
fields.doc: wheel diameter in mm

fields.name: encoder_ppr
fields.doc: encoder pulses per motor-shaft revolution, one channel

fields.name: gear_ratio
fields.doc: gear ratio as a decimal; 1:9 is 9.0 (held as ratio x100 inside)

fields.name: quadrature
fields.doc: quadrature edge multiplier

domains.doc: Distances between wheel centres. The track feeds the app's manoeuvre geometry.

fields.name: track_mm
fields.doc: lateral distance between left and right wheel centres

fields.name: wheelbase_mm
fields.doc: longitudinal distance between front and rear wheel centres

domains.doc: The FPV encoder and the video switch. bitrate_kbps applies at the next stream start; enabled applies at once.

fields.name: bitrate_kbps
fields.doc: target H.264 bitrate in kbit/s; the adapter's USB (Full-Speed, one transfer block per host read) drains ~4 Mbit/s at the car's 3 ms chunk pacing, measured 2026-09-16, and the car's own pacing caps it at 3.7 — 2500 leaves the gap for keyframes and motion

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: the car streams video at all; false and it ignores every view, ends a running subscription on the video control task's next tick (≤100 ms; the encoder and the sensor follow within a frame) and puts the sensor in standby — the drive screen's video button, remembered on the car

calibration.doc: GET /calibration returns calibrated and the wheels table (empty when not calibrated). POST /calibration takes wheels: four corners, each once, pairs 0..3 each once, inverted per wheel. POST /calibration/spin takes pair and direction.

video.doc: The FPV stream: H.264 Annex B chunks on UDP `port`, one chunk per datagram. Header, big-endian: u8 proto (wire_proto), u8 flags (bit0 keyframe), u8 stream (+1 per stream start), u8 reserved (0), u16 frame (from 0 per stream, modulo 2^16), u8 chunk, u8 count, u32 captured_ms. Every chunk but the last is exactly chunk_bytes. width x height is the encoded picture: the middle `height` rows of the sensor's `sensor_height`-row frame (the fisheye's top and bottom, which the viewer would crop anyway, are never encoded). fps is nominal — the car encodes every sensor_fps/fps-th sensor frame (rounded down), so 22 is really 22.5. The phone subscribes with a `view` datagram on the same port every subscribe_ms; subscribe_timeout_ms without one stops the stream. keyframe_s is the planned IDR period; a `view` with key:true forces one, at most every idr_min_ms. rotation/mirror are applied by the viewer.

vectors.name: p-frame at the counter's edge, last chunk
